### [`unused_ce07`](../../../../src/leftovers/leftover_ce07.asm#L6) `$CE07-$CEFF`

*data*

Nothing reads these bytes: 9 bytes $ff, then 240 bytes $a3. $cf00-$cf21 is not in the program. Build V 05 05 87 has the $00/$ff RAM fill pattern at $cdb6-$cfff.
